Scenario fixture: rgaa-field-label-in-name-sources

Each target has a stable id of the form fins_case_NN. RGAA 11.2.5 checks that the source that gives the accessible name of a field (aria-labelledby, else aria-label, else the <label>, else the title) contains its visible label, word for word. Punctuation and capital letters are ignored; accents, abbreviations, word endings and text in parentheses are not.

A. The source that gives the name does not contain the visible label (FAIL)

02 — FAIL: aria-label that replaces the label
04 — FAIL: checkbox role whose aria-label does not contain its text
J’accepte
05 — FAIL: the aria-label leaves out the text in parentheses
13 — FAIL: the aria-label holds a visible word with another ending
14 — FAIL: the aria-label writes out the abbreviation shown

B. Asked about (CANTTELL)

15 — CANTTELL: the visible label is one character, which may be a symbol

C. The source that gives the name contains the visible label (PASS)

01 — PASS: a title that does not repeat the label is not judged, since the label gives the name
03 — PASS: the title, which does not give the name, drops an accent and is not judged
06 — PASS: title that starts with the label
07 — PASS: aria-labelledby text that contains the label
Nom de famille
08 — PASS: wrapping label whose select option text is not part of the label

D. Out of scope (NOT APPLICABLE)

09 — NOT APPLICABLE: a label and no other source
10 — NOT APPLICABLE: no visible label
11 — NOT APPLICABLE: a submit button is not a field
12 — PASS: visually hidden text in the label is not part of the visible label
